$comment: The G20 parts we already have as our own drawings (the bench simulation bench/g20/ and the app's G20 scene textures), one record per part, linked to design/overlay/g20_comfort.json. Written by tools/overlay/inventory_parts.py; do not edit. No pixels here: the files are referenced in place. See README.md section 6.

Our own seeded street layout (never BMW's data) inside map.region with the measured edge fade; background, road colours and widths per look from 08 (night) and 09 (day). Streets drift down at speed (m/s) * px_per_m (weak: 1 px/m). Drawn under B's semi-transparent dial faces.
Red chevron at map.position_arrow (fixed; the streets move).

Semi-transparent dark veil over map.region where the dial faces overlap the map (left and right ends). Alpha = 1 - road contrast(x) / plateau, fitted as two logistic ramps [1.0, 598.13, 53.46, 1.0, 1320.77, 53.46]. Only the roads' attenuation is in it; the map's own darker background fade at its ends is NOT (D's map). Drop or tune it when calibrating with D's map.
